attchmntText: Fertilizers and Chemicals Travancore Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: The Board of Directors of The Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore Limited held a meeting on 13th November, 2026, at 11.00 AM. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The meeting concluded at 01.15 PM.
